verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs claim "speaker recognition" in live transcription and list "taggable speakers" on the pricing page, so diarization plus attaching names to speakers is a first-party capability. However, the pack never says names are matched automatically or describes how accurate the attribution is, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic real-name matching (e.g. calendar or voice-profile matching) versus manual tagging, details of how diarization works, and independent or hands-on evidence of attribution accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
